paragraphs.text:
Norman can’t hold on and begins to slip. Sylvia grabs him, and 
she too is pulled into the water. You see them tossed by the 
turbulence and thrown against rocks. Without your help, both 
will surely die.

To attempt a hazardous rescue, go to 227. To remain on the bank, 
go to 67.
